parrafo_1.es: Alex Pro Garage LLC es un taller y mecánico móvil con base en Hollywood, FL. Alex se encarga de motor, diagnóstico, suspensión y electrónica, en el taller o donde estés, y te explica el problema antes de tocar nada.
parrafo_1.en: Alex Pro Garage LLC is a mobile mechanic and repair shop based in Hollywood, FL. Alex handles engine work, diagnostics, suspension and electronics, at the shop or on site, and talks you through the problem before any wrench turns.

parrafo_2.es: Las 90 reseñas de 5 estrellas en Google vienen de trabajos reales: cambios de alternador, inspecciones antes de comprar y reconstrucciones de motor completas, siempre manteniendo al cliente informado.
parrafo_2.en: The 90 five-star Google reviews come from real jobs: alternator swaps, pre-purchase inspections and full engine rebuilds, each one with the customer kept in the loop.

texto.es: Cuéntale qué hace tu auto y dónde estás. Responde él mismo, sin central telefónica.
texto.en: Tell him what your car is doing and where you are. He answers himself, no call center.

texto.es: Revisa el auto, en el taller o donde estés, y te dice qué tiene y cuánto cuesta antes de empezar.
texto.en: He checks the car, at the shop or wherever you are, and tells you what it needs and what it costs before starting.

texto.es: Hace el trabajo con las piezas y herramientas correctas, y te explica cada paso si preguntas.
texto.en: He does the job with the right parts and tools, and walks you through each step if you ask.

texto.es: Prueba el auto, te explica qué se hizo y queda disponible si surge algo después.
texto.en: He test drives the car, explains what was done, and stays reachable if anything comes up after.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según lo que necesite tu auto. Llama o escribe y Alex te da el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted on what your car needs. Call or text and Alex will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Desde alternadores hasta reconstrucciones de motor completas: Alex busca el problema real, no solo el síntoma.
texto.en: From alternators to full engine rebuilds, Alex finds the real problem and fixes it, not just the symptom.

texto.es: ¿Piensas comprar un auto usado? Alex lo revisa de punta a punta y te dice exactamente en qué te estás metiendo.
texto.en: Thinking about a used car? Alex checks it bumper to bumper and tells you exactly what you are getting into.

texto.es: ¿Quedaste varado o no puedes llegar al taller? Alex va hasta donde estés con las herramientas para resolverlo.
texto.en: Stuck on the side of the road or can't make it to a shop? Alex comes to your location with the tools to get it done.

texto.es: Cambios de pantalla con Bluetooth y Apple CarPlay, cableado y electrónica, instalados limpio y probados antes de irse.
texto.en: Screen upgrades with Bluetooth and Apple CarPlay, wiring and electronics done clean, with everything tested before he leaves.

pie.es: ¿No ves lo que necesita tu auto? Descríbelo y Alex te dice si puede ayudarte.
pie.en: Not sure what's wrong? Describe it and Alex will tell you if he can help.

items.quote: I happen to be on vacation with my family. We ended up being stuck on the side of the road. I was skeptical but so glad I did go with him. Alex was kind enough to rearrange his schedule to fit us in. His knowledge was spot on.
Alex is the best hands-down. I have other mechanics that I use sometimes when it's an emergency because Alex is booked a lot, because he is so great at what he does. He is very affordable.

Alex did an amazing job replacing the radio in my car to a new screen system that includes Bluetooth and Apple CarPlay. The installation is clean, professional, and everything works perfectly, even with model changes. He was knowledgeable.
I called Alex for a PPI (Pre Purchase Inspection) and I have to say it was the best money I have ever spent. Very reasonably priced compared to other places I called. He is super knowledgeable.
